title: BUG: confusing error message for DataFrame.plot()

labels.name: Error Reporting
labels.description: Incorrect or improved errors from pandas

body:
see also https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/17372#issuecomment-325759975

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example if possible

```python
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({'A': ["x", "y", "z"], 'B': [1, 2, 3]})
df['A'].plot()
```

```python-traceback
TypeError: no numeric data to plot
```
